title: Balanced Freekeh Tabouleh
subtitle: with Sumac Chickpeas and Pistachios
description: Load up on good things with this super-nourishing salad. Freekeh, the new 'it' supergrain, combines here with wholesome toasted chickpeas, parsley, pistachios and a medley of tomatoes for a delicious twist on Middle Eastern tabouleh.

steps.text: Cook freekeh: Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Cook the freekeh, partially covered, for 18-20 mins until tender. Drain.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, drain and rinse the chickpeas. Finely chop the onion. Halve the tomatoes or quarter any larger ones. Finely chop the parsley, including the stems. Cook the pistachios in a cold medium frypan over medium heat, tossing, for 3-4 mins until toasted. Remove from the pan, reserving the pan. Cool slightly, then coarsely chop.

Fry chickpeas and onion: Put the chickpeas, onion, sumac and 2 tsp olive oil in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper, then toss to combine. Heat the reserved pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chickpea mixture, stirring, for 5-7 mins until the chickpeas are browned and the onion is softened. Remove the pan from the heat.
Make dressing: Meanwhile, put 1½ tbs olive oil, 1 tbs red wine vinegar and 2 tsp honey in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and whisk to combine.

Serve up: Add the freekeh, chickpea mixture, tomato, pistachios and parsley to the dressing and toss to combine. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the freekeh tabouleh among bowls and enjoy!
Make it yours: If you have any herbs in the crisper drawer that need to be used, chop them up and stir through the salad just before serving. Fresh mint or coriander would work well.
